text: Reception reported 89 of 183 rooms occupied on Thursday 26 Nov (48.6%), 43 of them Rabdan, down from 92 on 25 Nov. There was 1 check-in (room 708) and 2 check-outs (rooms 1312 and 403). Reception logged no new inquiries, viewings, bookings or renewals, and 4 guest complaints, all resolved. Room 806 was extended by one night and invoiced.
Reports for 26 Nov came from Operations, the management office, Reception, Maintenance, IT, the Flower shop and AJ1881. HR & Accounts had an off day. No separate Housekeeping report was seen.

Maintenance logged 10 jobs, all marked done, including fused lamps in basements 1–3, the room 812 shattaf pipe, room 312 mirror lights, room 803 kitchen lights, the B4 ceiling refixing and painting in the B1 parking area. Still pending: ceiling painting in rooms 509–511, basement wall repair and painting, and B2 drainage chamber cleaning. Maintenance asked for approval to buy epoxy paint for the basement parking.

Waiting on management approval: the lift AMC (described as urgent), the security barrier remote quotation, the room 710 FCU motor rewinding, the epoxy paint purchase, the room 801 guest’s refund request, the florist recruitment package, the Faiz Investment meeting, the St Regis Pilates portfolio, AJ1881’s rename to Oui Cafe and its kitchen supplies.

Operations reported that ADNOC’s site visit, the HSE inspection and the HSE documents are complete with positive feedback, and Blumont is awaiting ADNOC management’s final approval. On Blumont’s side a certified HSE staff member and the final accommodation unit setup are still needed. On 27 Nov Accounts confirmed nothing further is needed from the HSE side.

Operations sent the Oui Café and central kitchen, laundry and swimming pool rental proposals, and sent the café outdoor seating documents to PAL Group for the permit. The flower shop space and car wash and valet proposals are still pending. Accommodation proposals went to five more companies, El Sewedy and a Rabdan Academy client made site visits, and BCT Flowers sent LifeCore Clinic a proposal for 6 vases; the clinic asked for bi-weekly service.

IT reported the software fixed and fully functional, with installation on all company laptops still to finish, and the new Meta Soft connection live with strong Wi-Fi. IT blocked and encoded key cards and fixed the reception printer; new cameras and the biometric data are still pending. PAL Group submitted the Reneco Tawtheeq application. AJ1881 sold AED 122 (beverages only) to 7 covers; the flower shop reported no sales.
